biggest_catch: $0 annual fee, so the $100 is pure upside on the fee side — but it is a once-per-account bonus and the payout timing could not be confirmed on the official terms page (it failed to load), so watch your account yourself after you hit the $500. Only planned spending counts toward the $500-in-90-days — never buy extra to hit it. Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, and the card's 20.49%–29.99% variable APR erases the $100 fast if you carry a balance — pay in full every month.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never buy extra things just to hit a bonus threshold; overspending to chase a bonus wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on it.
